continuity: Jeok Cheongang has advanced beyond the Three Saints, becoming the fourth star, and has killed the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord in their duel.
Jeok Cheongang remains committed to killing every member of Dark Heaven in vengeance for Hong Dao.
Immediately after killing the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord, Jeok Cheongang experiences sudden, unexplained cold pain throughout his body.
plot: Jeok Cheongang’s breakthrough gives him the strength to overwhelm and kill the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord. He says he vowed to kill every member of Dark Heaven after Hong Dao’s death; as he turns from the fallen Demon Lord, an inexplicable cold pain suddenly sweeps through his body.
translation_decisions: Retain “fourth star” for the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord’s description of Jeok Cheongang’s place beyond the Three Saints.
Render 극염 as “Extreme Flame,” distinguishing it from the earlier “Extreme Yang.”

active_continuity: Jeok Cheongang has surpassed the Three Saints and killed the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord.
Jeok Cheongang vowed to kill every member of Dark Heaven after Hong Dao was killed by the Blood Lord.
Jeok Cheongang suffers unexplained cold pain immediately after the duel.
open_questions: What caused the sudden pain that struck Jeok Cheongang after the duel?
Can Jeok Cheongang fulfill his vow to kill every member of Dark Heaven?

profile_updates.current: - **Role:** Jeok Cheongang is the current Sect Leader of the Fire Gate Clan, a legendary wandering martial master who has achieved Five Qi Returning to Origin, Furnace Fire Pure Blue, and Returned to Youth, Jin Taekyung's Master who has broken free of his Heart Demon and entered a new realm, the occupant of the chief seat of the Murim Alliance's Five Kings Hall, and a trusted confidant who accepts Jin as himself despite knowing that he travels between Murim and another world resembling the realm of immortals.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Role:** Jeok Cheongang is the Fire Gate Clan’s current Sect Leader, a legendary martial master who has surpassed the Three Saints, Jin Taekyung’s Master and intended heir’s mentor, and a trusted confidant who occupies the chief seat of the Murim Alliance’s Five Kings Hall.
